description: The ZIP checksum (IEEE 802.3 CRC-32, the engine's slice-by-8 implementation) of inline bytes / text or a sandbox file (streamed in 1 MiB chunks). `seed` continues a running CRC across consecutive chunks; `expect` compares against a known value (`matches`). Use it to cross-check an entry's crc32 from list_zip_entries against a file on disk.

dataBase64.description: Bytes as base64. Exclusive with text / sourcePath.

expect.description: Optional expected CRC (1–8 hex digits, optional 0x prefix, e.g. '4e08bfb4'); the result carries `matches`.

seed.description: Running CRC to continue from (chain calls over consecutive chunks).

sourcePath.description: Relative path of a file inside the sandbox (streamed, ≤ 1 GiB). Exclusive with dataBase64 / text.

text.description: UTF-8 text. Exclusive with dataBase64 / sourcePath.

name: compute_crc32
title: Compute CRC-32
